item.content:encoded: Definitely my favorite Little Mister so far. I love the way he speaks, and how he seems to care so much for the kids and know so much about them. Also, the whole confusion about why he's Mister Hot? Brilliant! And the set of interviews got me thinking about the motivations of the interviewer? Like, was she inquiring about the "gifts" because she was seriously considering letting him give them to her kids? Or was she just humoring him? Or was she just doing it to find out more about him and Wondertainment? Or was she doing it to get the "gifts" to contain them? I have a feeling its a mixture of all of them, but its still a lot to think about. Its not very often a scip gets me to think this deeply about people that arent author avatars or part of GoIs. Well done, you've very muchly earned my +1!

For some, they have no qualms over Site names being censored since those with access to SCP articles would likely be workers of that particular Site (and it can be a failsafe against spies finding out the locations of particular SCPs).

In this particular case, we should take note that it is a Little Mister SCP. Their trademark (as seen in their counterparts) is the blackboxed Site where they are kept. I suppose it is to maintain canon among the Little Mister SCPs.

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded: Every time I see a post like this, I say the same thing, so I'll say it here (as I have time to respond): Blackboxing location details (like the Site # and the internal location) are one of the few acceptable redactions in the Containment. If you're working with it, you know where it is; if you aren't working with it and have need to know, you can contact RAISA.
